notes: Both *neither* and *lest* are read as single words fusing a waw with its negative, each headed on the negation (rule 35).
*him* in *give him his hire* is added, on the model of rule 44's `וַיַּשְׁקְ` → *gave them drink*; the competing reading gives it to the suffix on שְׂכָרוֹ as a twice-realized pronoun under rule 18.
Of the two written הוּא, the first takes the single English *he* and the second is unrepresented (rule 22).
